contracts_changed: Added the Python DatasetAdapter and DataObservation protocol for explicit split/source identity, seeded subset selection, sample IDs, actual coverage, and adapter capability reporting.

Direct batch factories keep their existing binding behavior. A factory returning a Dataset-like or iterable source is sampled from the fresh instance produced by that factory; callers can still explicitly bind nested args/kwargs/envelopes.

Dataset state is resumable only when save/load hooks or an explicit stateless declaration exist. Iterable-only sources report bounded-prefix coverage, unstable IDs, and unsupported resume when no state protocol exists.
implemented: Added indexed Dataset sampling with sha256-index-rank-v1 (stable across Python random-library changes), deterministic selected indices, optional unique sample IDs scoped by an explicit fingerprint, split/sample counts, and honest coverage metadata.

Added bounded sampling for iterable datasets. Each request gets a fresh factory instance; only the bounded prefix is consumed, and it is never described as representative or replayable without supporting IDs/state hooks.
Added Python state_dict/load_state_dict capability detection and an explicit MODEL_MAVEN_STATELESS opt-in. Unsupported cursor restoration includes a user-facing reason.

Kept arbitrary nested values and multi-input batches intact; Dataset items use PyTorch default_collate when available, while DataLoader-like values that already represent batches are not collated a second time.
Added application-level checks for empty batch references, batch parameters without a source, and binding without a source.

Coordinator embedded data/adapters.py, hardened unspecified seed handling for CLI-generated null seeds, and added data_observation to successful forward/backward probe reports plus forward failure evidence. An end-to-end CLI test verifies sample identity, algorithm, population and cursor capability.
